name: hullbreaker-assets
description: Dev-only asset pipeline for HULLBREAKER: SVG->PNG rasterizer, palette/manifest/size checker, in-game-scale viewer, codex spec wrapper. Not part of the game runtime.
//: playwright-core is listed so `npm install` here works as a standalone fallback, but installing it is NOT the expected path: lib/browser.mjs resolves tools/playtest/node_modules first, so the harness's single existing install serves both tools. check.mjs needs no dependency at all.
